feed.title: Niccolò Ridi: what’s new
feed.subtitle: Data essays, tools and projects on public international law from niccoloridi.com.

entry.title: The Invisible College, Mapped
entry.summary: A network of 180 international lawyers and 226 ties, drawn from a century of obituaries in the British Yearbook of International Law (with Luíza Leão Soares Pereira).

entry.title: ILC Atlas
entry.summary: A documentary explorer for the work of the International Law Commission: chronological, filterable by actor, and backed by a knowledge graph.

entry.title: echr-py
entry.summary: An open-source toolkit for European Court of Human Rights case law, with a citation-network replication of Voeten and Lupu's study of the Grand Chamber.

entry.title: Agentic Law Journal
entry.summary: A call for machine-authored scholarship across every field of law and legal thought, and experiments in legal argument.

entry.title: cjeu-py
entry.summary: An open-source toolkit for Court of Justice of the European Union case law, with an analysis of 1,020 Grand Chamber decisions and their citations.

entry.title: Custom in the Making
entry.summary: Agent-based models of how customary international law forms across observation structures and institutional conditions.

entry.title: GenAI as an International Lawyer
entry.summary: Ten AI-generated memorials entered in the Jessup International Law Moot Court Competition and graded blind (with Damien Charlotin).

entry.title: The Citation Network of the UN Security Council
entry.summary: 2,488 Security Council resolutions and 12,399 citations between them, and what the Council uses its earlier resolutions for (with Lorenzo Gasbarri).
